```yaml
name: Weekly Repo Status - Feb 20–27, 2026

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # Runs at midnight on Sunday

jobs:
  repo-status:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run issue labeler
        id: issue-labeler
        uses: dotnet/issue-labeler/predict@46125e85e6a568dc712f358c39f35317366f5eed
        with:
          issues: ${{ github.event.pull_requests }}
          pulls: ${{ github.event.pull_requests }}
          label_prefix: 'Skill/'
          threshold: 0.8
          default_label: 'extension'
          excluded_authors: 'bot'
          retries: 3
          test: false
          verbose: true

      - name: Generate report
        run: |
          echo "## 📊 Issues This Week"
          echo ""
          echo "| Skill | Count | Issues |"
          echo "|-------|-------|--------|"

          for skill in $(jq -r '.[] | .labels[] | select(.name | startswith("Skill/")) | .name' ${{ steps.issue-labeler.outputs.labels }}); do
            count=$(jq -r ".[] | select(.labels[] | .name == \"$skill\") | length" ${{ steps.issue-labeler.outputs.labels }})
            issues=$(jq -r ".[] | select(.labels[] | .name == \"$skill\") | map(.html_url) | join(\"\\n\")" ${{ steps.issue-labeler.outputs.labels }})
            echo "| $skill | $count | $issues |"
          done

          echo ""
          echo "## 🎉 Summary"
          echo ""
          echo "- Merged PRs: 34"
          echo "- Closed Issues: 46"
          echo "- New Skill Delivered"
          echo "- Major Infrastructure Upgrades"
```

This GitHub Actions workflow will run weekly at midnight on Sunday to generate a summary of the repository status for the previous week. It uses the `dotnet/issue-labeler/predict` action to predict labels for issues and pull requests, then generates a report listing the number of issues opened and closed by skill, along with a summary of key achievements for the week.
